Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Extensive Reading: Grade appropriate fiction Materials - Characters

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 9.2.1 Extensive Reading: Grade appropriate fiction Materials - Characters, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can the characters in a story be described? 2. Why are some stories more enjoyable to read than others?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 9.2.1 Extensive Reading: Grade appropriate fiction Materials - Characters together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: The learner role plays different characters.

● Digital literacy: The learners search online and video record their performances.

Values:
Social justice- Reading on African heroes/ heroines makes learners understand issues that Africa as a continent is exposed to.
